com.ecom.admin.release_notes:
Maintenance release.

- Login screen now shows the app's own name instead of the shared product name, so you can tell at a glance which app you opened.
- Internal build and packaging improvements.

IMPORTANT - please delete the existing app before installing. This release is signed with a new security key, so Android will refuse to update over an older build. Your data is safe on the server; you only need to sign in again.

com.ecom.order.release_notes:
Wage Statement has been redesigned for readability and print quality:

- Much larger fonts throughout the statement. The time table now splits each day into a main row and a detail line instead of squeezing nine columns together.
- Earnings and deductions are now separate tables, each using the full width.
- The NET PAY box no longer prints a solid dark background - it uses a bold outline instead, which saves a significant amount of toner on every printed statement.
- Meal charges show count x unit price, and daily misc pay is listed per day, so totals can be verified.
- Page margins were re-tuned so the statement reliably fits on a single Letter page.
- Employee and employer signature lines are now aligned at the same height.

IMPORTANT - please delete the existing app before installing. This release is signed with a new security key, so Android will refuse to update over an older build. Your data is safe on the server; you only need to sign in again.

com.ecom.hrm.release_notes:
Payroll recalculation no longer dead-ends.

- The Recalc count on the HRM home screen now counts only payroll you can actually recalculate. Payroll that is already signed, distributed or paid is excluded, because recalculating it is blocked.
- Opening one of those locked payrolls now explains why, and what to do about it, instead of failing with an error code when you save.
- The payroll status chart showed raw internal labels in every language. It now reads Confirmed, Paid, and so on.
- Today's Attendance on the HRM home screen was always empty. Clocked In, Working and Pending were always zero. All four now show real numbers.
- Order notifications no longer mix a Korean unit into English text.

com.ecom.supply.release_notes:
Business Analytics charts work again, and month labels are in English.

- Every chart on the Analytics screen showed 'chart library not loaded' and stayed blank. The charting library was missing from the app package. It is now included, so charts draw without any network round trip.
- The month axis on the revenue chart printed Korean month labels. It now reads Jan, Feb, Mar.
- New order notifications no longer mix a Korean unit into English text.
